description: Asymmetric regression coverage of the two FOUNDER_TEST seams. The GIG_SETTLE_TX seam has an explicit prod-ignored regression test (settle.test.mjs:41-47: without FOUNDER_TEST the env var is ignored -> no_tx, not profitable), but the sibling GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON seam (settle-tx.mjs:45) has NO equivalent test asserting it is ignored when FOUNDER_TEST is unset. settle-tx.test.mjs only exercises the seam WITH FOUNDER_TEST=1. The gate IS present in code and the seam is NOT reachable from the model's ANICCA_ARGS (run.sh parses only mode/jobId/amount/proposal) and no prod path sets GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON, so this is NON-EXPLOITABLE and violates no PASS criterion. It is a defense-in-depth regression guard only: if a future edit dropped `process.env.FOUNDER_TEST === '1' &&` from settle-tx.mjs:45, no test would fail.
recommendedFix: Add one test to settle-tx.test.mjs that sets GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON WITHOUT FOUNDER_TEST and (with fromBlock/toBlock supplied so no network is hit, or BASE_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1) asserts representativeExternalTx does NOT consume the injected logs -> returns null. This gives the GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON gate the same prod-ignored regression guard that GIG_SETTLE_TX already has at settle.test.mjs:41-47.
